fairness_basis: Jain over all 90 UEs after rates below coverage_floor are zeroed; raw Jain also reported
selection: best.pt by fixed-seed mean normalized TCF score, ties earliest; utility supplementary
scope: Fresh 120k network-v3 training. UMa-AV mean BS-UAV channel, explicit BS/UAV power, selected geometry; TCF weights .45/.45/.10. Old checkpoints are inference controls only. Not hardware validation or a final multi-seed benchmark.

selection.channel_selection: UMa-AV for BS25m/aerial receiver by terminal geometry and primary equations, not by reward ranking
selection.power_selection: minimum of 20/30/43dBm that supports an isolated 200Mbps relay load at BOTH audited heights with 300m hops; UAV fixed20dBm
selection.radius_height_selection: maximize matched-frame mean TCF .45/.45/.10 among selected channel/power and raw edge Access>=4.4Mbps/UE for25UE; within0.005 score prefer smaller radius then lower height
selection.scope: Reference configuration in this diagnostic; not hardware validation or globally optimal design
